items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 9 at 11:23AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A large westerly swell will continue to produce breaking waves at
the Ventura Harbor entrance into the evening. These conditions
have a history of capsizing vessels of various sizes resulting in
serious injury or death, even to the most experienced mariners.
Mariners are urged to stay clear of the harbor entrance. For more
information, contact the local harbor patrol or coast guard
station, and continue to monitor NOAA Weather Radio for the latest
weather information..
